name: Cryonic-Astrolabe
description: Grass-plains and basalt shields alternate across the habitable belt, stitched together by magnetic pole anomalies. Farther poleward, past a nearby asteroid belt, the silence feels older than the soil.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
The ruins predate every charted civilization, and whatever built the derelict space station in orbit left in a hurry. Doors seal from the outside. Nobody has explained why.
For traders, geothermal energy alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
